mapper.select: SELECT item_id, title, category, tags, description, popularity FROM WHERE item_id IN #{id}
SELECT item_id FROM ORDER BY item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO (item_id, title, category, tags, description, popularity) VALUES (#{item.itemId}, #{item.title}, #{item.category}, #{tags,typeHandler=com.recsys.persistence.typehandler.TextListTypeHandler}, #{item.description}, #{item.popularity}) ON CONFLICT (item_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, category = EXCLUDED.category, tags = EXCLUDED.tags, description = EXCLUDED.description, popularity = EXCLUDED.popularity
